Arrival timing of Dara has no bearing on species count rankings.
Dara carrying a field guide is unrelated to the height comparison between Pia and Otto.

Height comparison between Pia and Otto has no bearing on Uma nodding in agreement.

Pia's height relative to Otto has no bearing on Otto's age relative to Ivo.
